C0490.title: Guangzhou Chen Developed Ticket Scalping Crawler Software Case
C0490.summary: Between 2017 and 2019, Chen in Guangzhou developed a crawler software to scalp tickets on the Damai.cn platform for illegal profit, selling it for prices ranging from 1,888 to 6,888 yuan. The software was verified to simulate user identification and input graphical CAPTCHAs through unconventional means, bypassing the platform's human-machine verification mechanism.
